en: Black-and-white postcard view of a large Catholic sanctuary complex with a central basilica and tall bell tower topped by a cross, flanked by long colonnades forming a semicircular square. A prominent tree stands in the foreground in a circular planter, and a small kiosk-like building appears to the right. The lower border of the image includes multilingual captions identifying the site as the Sanctuary of Fátima.
